description.value: Pind Balluchi is a North Indian restaurant in Williams Lake, BC, serving a broad menu of tandoori dishes, curries, biryanis, and street-food appetizers. It stands out as one of the few Indian dining options in the Cariboo interior, making it a notable meal stop for cyclists on long-haul routes through the region. Online ordering with 15-minute pickup is available, which suits cyclists who want a hot meal ready on arrival.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pindballuchi.ca is fully functional and confirms the OSM name, address (23C 1 Ave S, Williams Lake, BC V2G1H4), and phone (+1 778-412-2829). The site's 'Order Online / Pickup 15 min' feature confirms takeout availability, and the menu page lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' section with many plant-based options. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website and confirmed contact details. A useful meal and pickup stop for touring cyclists passing through Williams Lake.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' section with items such as Vegetable Korma, Aloo Gobi, Palak Paneer, Dal Makhani, Chana Masala, Malai Kofta, and others. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
